testcase.name: Scenario: Decline grouping an additional feature type: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-model-browser-source/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:419:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Decline grouping an additional feature type ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is open in the MCAD Software with the Find dialog open ✔ And the criteria list contains Type equals Extrusion OR Type equals Fillet ✔ And the criteria list contains Suppress status equals Suppressed ✔ And And is selected for additional criteria ✔ When the user chooses Type equals Hole and clicks Add to list ✔ Then a prompt offers to group the additional type criterion using OR ✔ When the user chooses No ✔ Then the prompt closes and the existing three criteria remain in the list ✔ And Type equals Hole is not added to the list ✔ And the property, condition and value controls still show Type equals Hole ✔ When the user closes the Find dialog ✔ Then the part remains visible
